scope: STEP2 future-version proposal only; v3.12 and every sealed race remain immutable
method: Trial 100-yen increments on unchanged selected WIN ticket combinations; compute exact modeled cross-type P(net payout >= total spend) using the already sealed odds and correlated top-three outcome distributions; choose largest material non-loss probability improvement with expected-profit and low-scenario risk floors; report win-only break-even stake and full portfolio odds.
guards: Must not change any original prestart sealed final_bets, STEP1, history, source odds, results, or currently active formal optimizer.
Only candidate win-ticket stake amounts can change; no ticket additions, no changes to other bet types.
Never compute stakes from known finish results; all future activation requires a new prestart version and verification.
Preserve baseline central EV within smaller of 10 percent or 200 yen; require positive modeled portfolio EV.
Reject a low-scenario modeled profit decline over 200 yen and low-scenario net-loss increase over 2 percentage points.
Require at least +1 percentage point central probability of nonnegative portfolio profit; no automatic spend-to-limit.
Historical model is uncalibrated; outputs are exploratory and not actual odds guarantee.
activation: Only after a separately approved formally versioned pipeline and end-to-end regression. This policy commits a tested pilot, not a change in the latest approved official JRA prediction.
